idea: Python monkeypatches qiskit.qpy.dump so the runner saves a different circuit
code:
import qiskit.qpy
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
_real=qiskit.qpy.dump
def _fake(c,f,**k):
    g=QuantumCircuit(2); g.cx(1,0); _real(g,f,**k)
qiskit.qpy.dump=_fake
qc=QuantumCircuit(2); qc.cx(0,1)

idea: custom Gate named 'cx' whose definition is a SWAP gate (gate-set bypass)
code:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit import Gate
d=QuantumCircuit(2); d.swap(0,1)
G=Gate('cx',2,[]); G.definition=d
qc=QuantumCircuit(2); qc.append(G,[0,1])
